YOUR INTENT, CONNECTED.

From a vague request to a useful workplace brief

Illustrative example — before: “Summarize this meeting.”

After: “Summarize these notes for the operations team. Separate decisions, open questions, and action items. Use only the supplied notes. List owners and dates only when stated; flag missing information.”

Summarize notes →Share an incident update →Plan a project →

Promptly organizes instructions into a prompt. It does not call AI models or verify facts. Review AI responses before using them. Work stays in this browser; download editable JSON backups.

Your original stored data is untouched. Download the original for recovery. You can edit and export a temporary brief, but saving is paused. Repair or remove damaged browser storage only after keeping a backup.

Edit your brief

Guided values

Fields replace named {{variables}} wherever they appear. Advanced edits keep the tokens or replace them with fixed text. Changing a field only changes its tokens; it never rewrites your sections.

Add a reusable variable

This instructs the eventual AI; it does not guarantee model behavior.

References are labeled content, separate from instructions. Delimiters do not eliminate prompt-injection risk. Pasted URLs are not fetched.

Context & voice profiles (optional)

Include a profile explicitly. Its editable snapshot stays with this brief until you refresh it.

Advanced section editor

Every instruction is editable. Remove or add sections as needed.

＋ Add details

Task, Context, Constraints, and Output format cover most briefs. Add optional details when helpful.

Your working draft autosaves. Save as new creates a completed prompt; Update adds a saved version. Templates are reusable starting points with separate working copies.

Preview prompt

Saved prompts & backups

Your prompt collection

Backups include the working brief, saved prompts, and archived prompts. Import adds copies to your collection and keeps your current brief.

Content stays in this browser. No account or API key. Browser storage can be cleared or reach its quota: download backups regularly.

A LITTLE STRUCTURE

Your judgment.
A clearer brief.

Build reusable AI briefs for writing, explaining, planning, reviewing, and summarizing common workplace tasks. Tell the AI what to do, who it is for, which facts it may use, and what the output should look like. Add only details that help. Promptly organizes instructions into Markdown. It does not call models or verify supplied facts; review every AI response before using it.

Start with your next workplace task.

Export unfinished brief?

There are completeness checks to review. You can deliberately copy or export this as an unfinished template. Completeness does not guarantee an accurate AI response.

Replace working draft?

Your current working draft will be replaced. Save it to My prompts first if you need a lasting copy. Undo will also restore it during this session.
